text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: spike in 5xxs & timeouts on embeddings route (/v1/embeddings). 5xx rate up ~18% over 10m, downstream queues growing. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

alex: on it. grabbing logs and metrics. any customer spikes called out in alerts?

riya: seeing a few customer tails — corpA and searchify heavy on embeddings. chat (/v1/chat) looks stable. rerank route latency increased but not 5xxing.

dave: quick thought — we should do a surgical per-route quota tweak for embeddings first, not global limits. reduce embeddings route capacity and lift chat backlog risk.

kim: agreed. propose: route rate-limit /v1/embeddings -> 60rps aggregate, per-customer soft cap 100rps -> 20rps. keep chat/rerank unchanged. Anyone object? :thinking_face:

alex: no objections. that should throttle noisy embedters and relieve host queues. i'll prepare the change.

riya: i'm tailing requests and KV cache evictions look correlated with embeddings burst. throttling should help cache churn too.

alex: applying configuration now via admin API. command: ```
POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/ratelimits
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "type": "aggregate",
  "limit_rps": 60,
  "per_customer_soft_rps": 20,
  "mode": "enforced"
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for config-change-ratelimit-embeddings (run id: cfg-2026-03-17-11).

jordan: I'll take oncall for the next 2 hours once change lands. kim can handoff after validation.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: config-change-ratelimit-embeddings succeeded (10/10 services). No rolling restarts required.

riya: initial telemetry: 5xx rate on embeddings down from 4.1% -> 0.9% in 6m. request queue length dropped ~45%. customers corpA and searchify showing reduced error surfacing.

dave: good. follow-up: add a temporary route-specific hold for rerank if we see latency escalations — but leave alone for now. Also create a quick dashboard showing per-route p50/p95/p99 and per-customer embed usage so support can triage.

alex: adding dashboard and support note. support playbook snippet: "If a customer reports embeddings failures, check /admin/ratelimits for per-customer soft cap and request adjustment via account ops if warranted."

kim: handoff: I'm oncall until 02:00 UTC. jordan will monitor for config regressions. escalate to infra if 5xx > 2% again or embedding latency > 1s p95.

jordan: watching. setting a temporary alert suppress for noisy false positives to avoid alert fatigue while we stabilize. :white_check_mark:

riya: customer impact summary for postmortem: small number of customers experienced elevated 5xxs during burst windows. Mitigation: per-route aggregate throttle + per-customer soft caps. No data loss, some requests retried by clients. Recommend permanent quota policy review for high-embedding users.

alex: closing live mitigation. will create a follow-up ticket for longer-term actions: quota policy, autoscaling of embed workers, and better per-customer dashboarding. tagging infra and product.

incident-bot: STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. reopen thread if error rates climb.
